en.headline: Police log 29,670 fraud cases in first eight months
en.dek: Losses reached HK$5.21 billion, up 3.8% on last year, as police warned of new fake customer-service tactics.
body: Police said Hong Kong recorded 29,670 fraud cases from January to August, 4.5% more than the 28,379 cases in the same period last year. Losses were HK$5.21 billion, up 3.8% from HK$5.02 billion. Fake customer-service cases accounted for more than 5,000 reports and nearly HK$700 million in losses.

Police said the overall fraud picture was relatively stable, but fake customer-service cases had risen sharply in recent months. They described two newer tactics: one in which callers posing as customer-service staff persuade people to install a malicious app and switch on a phone's near-field function so a bank card held to the phone can be charged; and another in which a supposed verification code is entered as a transfer amount. Police cited an August case in which a 53-year-old woman lost HK$4.46 million, and another in which a 74-year-old man lost HK$3.4 million after responding to a message posing as a courier.

The Office of the Communications Authority said more than 880 companies and organisations had registered under the SMS sender registration scheme by August, so their messages begin with a hash sign. Chief regulatory affairs manager Chan Kin-leung said isolated scam messages had also been seen starting with that sign, sent from illegal mobile devices using 2G technology.

zh.headline: 首八個月錄得近三萬宗詐騙案 損失52.1億元
zh.dek: 警方指今年首八個月詐騙案較去年同期升4.5%，假冒客服手法近期明顯增加，並出現新變種。
body: 警方表示，今年一月至八月本港錄得29670宗詐騙案，較去年同期的28379宗上升4.5%；損失金額52.1億元，較去年同期的50.2億元增加3.8%。其中假冒客服騙案超過5000宗，損失近7億元。
警方指整體騙案形勢大致平穩，但假冒客服案件近月明顯上升，並出現變種手法。其一是騙徒假冒客服，誘使事主下載惡意程式及開啟手機近場通訊功能，再把信用卡貼近手機背面，藉此盜用信用卡簽帳；另一種則以驗證帳戶為由，誘導事主把假驗證碼輸入轉帳金額欄。警方舉例，八月一名53歲女子損失446萬元，另一名74歲男子收到假冒速遞公司訊息後損失340萬元。
通訊事務管理局辦公室表示，短訊發送人登記制度截至八月已有超過880間公司或機構登記，發出的短訊會以「#」號開頭。辦公室首席規管事務經理陳建良說，曾發現零星詐騙短訊同樣以「#」號開頭，有關訊息由非法流動裝置透過2G技術發送。
